picks.title: Bending Spoons to buy Airtable for $1.28B
picks.why_it_matters: A landmark down-round acquisition (from $11B to $1.28B) signals continued valuation compression in productivity SaaS and creates potential talent/customer displacement opportunities for emerging startups.

picks.title: Scoop: Inside Trump's AI framework
picks.why_it_matters: Excluding open-source models from government AI testing frameworks could reshape competitive dynamics, potentially disadvantaging startups building on open models while favoring closed-source incumbents.
